summary: Python TDD bridge identified by tdd_bridge.py; required inputs: repository root, plan directory, slice ID, one or more snapshot paths; optional materialize-only mode; loads implementation contract and command registry; materialize mode requires snapshot paths exactly match slice declaration and returns no authorizations; execution runs red expecting failure, green and each refactor expecting success, then terminal command; commands use declared executable/arguments, repository cwd, captured output, timeout; creates unique UTC run log directory; stage mismatch writes failure record and exits 2; terminal failure writes terminal record and exits 2; successful validation derives slice roots, writes predicate result with plan/slice/contract hash and empty authorizations; updates plan run-state to route; emits run ID and slice ID; ambiguities: exceptions from missing/invalid contract entries or subprocess timeout are uncaught
